name: pro.publifye/brreg
title: Brreg
description: Norway's company register (Enhetsregisteret) for AI: lookup, search, name resolution, key financials

tools.name: code_list
tools.description: Filter values with counts from the current snapshot: list org_form, municipality, nace or sector; query matches a code prefix or description. Use them as entity_search filters. Example: code_list list

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: Exact lookup by organisasjonsnummer in Enhetsregisteret; never fuzzy. orgnr (one) or orgnrs (several, in input order); spaces and dots tolerated. Items are {orgnr, found, record?, reason?}, reason inv

tools.name: entity_resolve

tools.name: entity_search
tools.description: Ranked, filtered search over current and historical names, addresses and websites. Give at least one of query, address, website, match or a filter. Filters: kind, org_form (code_list codes), municipal
